newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles says Delham stake is technical.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles says Delham stake is technical.

text.p: Retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Friday that the statement by Asian investor Delham Investments Pte Ltd that it had a 6.8 percent stake reflected the technical requirements of local corporate regulations.
Delham has a 20 percent stake in Brierley Investments Ltd, which owns 6.8 percent of Coles.

"It's a technical requirement in the corporations law and it's really just coming about because...this investment group has 20 percent of Brierley. I don't think there's anything sinister behind it," manager corporate administration Michael Irving told Reuters. -- Melbourne bureau 61-3 9286-1435
